// Native coverage of generated typed AST interfaces and accessors.
use syntax_complete::{
    SyntaxNode,
    ast::{self, AstNode},
};
fn round<'t, N: AstNode<'t>>(n: N, node: SyntaxNode<'t>) {
    assert!(N::can_cast(node.kind()));
    assert!(N::cast(node).is_some());
    assert_eq!(n.syntax(), node);
    assert_eq!(n.syntax(), node); // inherited Copy
}
fn find<'t, N: AstNode<'t>>(node: SyntaxNode<'t>) -> Option<N> {
    node.children().find_map(N::cast)
}
fn all<'t>(root: SyntaxNode<'t>) {
    // GENERATED_INTERFACES
    println!("find expr {:?}", find::<ast::Expr<'t>>(root).map(|n| n.syntax()));
    println!("find type {:?}", find::<ast::Type<'t>>(root).map(|n| n.syntax()));
    if let Some(x) = ast::IfExpr::cast(root) {
        println!("extension {:?}", x.condition());
        println!("extension {:?}", x.then_branch());
        println!("extension {:?}", x.else_branch());
    }
    if let Some(x) = ast::WhileExpr::cast(root) {
        println!("extension {:?}", x.condition());
        println!("extension {:?}", x.loop_body());
    }
    if let Some(x) = ast::ForExpr::cast(root) {
        println!("extension {:?}", x.iterable());
        println!("extension {:?}", x.loop_body());
    }
    if let Some(x) = ast::Impl::cast(root) {
        println!("extension {:?}", x.trait_ty());
        println!("extension {:?}", x.self_ty());
    }
    if let Some(x) = ast::PathSegment::cast(root) {
        println!("extension {:?}", x.self_ty());
        println!("extension {:?}", x.trait_ty());
    }
}
fn main() {
    for text in [
        "fn f(){if true {} else {};while false{}for x in 0..1{} }",
        "struct S; impl Trait for S {fn f(){}} fn g(){<S as Trait>::f();}",
        "fn broken( { if true {",
        "impl { fn x( ; while { for in } < as >::",
        "",
        // PARSER_INPUTS
    ] {
        let p = syntax_complete::parse_source_file(text);
        println!("errors {}", p.errors().len());
        println!("items {}", p.source_file().items().count());
        all(p.root());
        for node in p.root().descendants() {
            println!("node {:?} {:?}", node.kind(), node.text_range());
            all(node);
        }
    }
}
